versions.content: Signature of Callback functions of AUTOSAR Services If the BSW Module provides Callback functions which are AUTOSAR Services , i.e. the function invocation is routed via RTE , then the signature of these functions shall follow the signature provided by the RTE to invoke servers via RTE_Call API.
